author: fwyzard
body:
Add the `openmp` and `openmp-simd` tools.

`openmp` _does not_ enable `-fopenmp`, it only enables linking with the `libgomp.so` library,  because CMSSW externals are always built with GCC, and so link with `libgomp.so` even in clang builds.
Why it does not enable `-fopenmp`:
  - the `-fopenmp` would propagate transitively to the dependent packages, and could enable unwanted behaviour in downstream users (_e.g._ enable OpenMP support in Eigen);
  - adding the `-fopenmp` flag here would make a clang build link `libomp.so`, loading two separate OpenMP runtimes;
  - adding the `-fopenmp=libgomp` flag for clang would make a clang build link `libgomp.so`, but it would also make clang silently disable OpenMP pragmas, because its code generator does not support the GCC-style implementation.

So the only safe option is to only link `libgomp.so`, and keep `-fopenmp` disabled. 

`openmp-simd` enables only the `-fopenmp-simd` flag, which does not enable general OpenMP support and does not need the OpenMP runtime, so it's safe to use.
title: Add GCC OpenMP tools
